fusions.name: Ten Thousand Cuts
fusions.desc: Looses 5 hair-thin blades in a fan, each of which deals 2 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangled Snap
fusions.desc: A whipping cut on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Braided Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5% while it holds.

fusions.name: Knot by Knot
fusions.desc: Every hit you land marks the target with a stack, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and a blow strikes it for 30% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
